title: Kayak Hotels Search Scraper
description: Search Kayak hotel listings with names, star levels, review scores, amenities, provider prices, and property links. Batch location IDs and compare future stays.

locations.title: KAYAK location IDs
locations.description: City, airport, or property location IDs to search for hotel offers.

location_id.title: Location Id
location_id.description: KAYAK location identifier for the city, airport, or property search.

location_type.title: Location Type
location_type.description: Type of KAYAK location identifier, such as a city, airport, or hotel. Accepted values: city, airport, hotel.

checkin.title: Checkin
checkin.description: Hotel check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. When omitted, check-in is set to 30 days from today.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.description: Hotel check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format, after check-in. When omitted, check-out is set to two days after check-in.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult travelers included in the search.

child_age.title: Child age
child_age.description: Age of one child in the hotel search, from 0 to 17.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Sort order for returned search results. Accepted values: rank_a, price_a, review_a.
